_comment: Copy to lifeway.json next to the program (or the repo root). Every key is optional. Secrets (GitLab token) stay in .env. URL parameters (?speed=2&mode=full&lang=en) still win over this file.
title: Our team · Git Life Way

film._comment: mode: highlights | full · speed: 1, 2, 4 … · times in seconds of real time

ranking._comment: Points per commit, merged MR and repository born in the period

ingest._comment: groups: GitLab groups (with subgroups) instead of «all my projects». include/exclude: path patterns (GitLab: group/project, local: folder name). excludeAuthors: name patterns of bots etc. aliveDays: a repo without changes for longer is «finished».
